The matcher first checks eligible explicit structural patterns. A structural winner is authoritative and may bind named String slots. If no structural rule wins, GVYA retrieves a bounded semantic candidate set, scores positive and negative evidence, then resolves only above the Bot threshold and outside its ambiguity margin.
